failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run mode fails to detect stale heartbeat files and omits the 'Found N items' summary line with '--force' hint
failures.fix: Fix the heartbeat staleness detection logic in sw-cleanup.sh and ensure dry-run summary always prints 'Found <n> item(s)' with a '--force' usage hint when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed command missing -e flag, causing substitution expression 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g' to be interpreted as a filename instead of an inline script
failures.fix: Add -e flag to the sed call: sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g" instead of sed "s|...|g"
